visa189RelatedPathwaysSection.subtitle: If 189 is too competitive right now, a stronger migration strategy may involve running another pathway in parallel.

0.title: State Nominated PR
0.desc: Adds 5 extra points and may be more realistic than waiting only on 189, depending on your occupation and state eligibility.

1.title: Regional Skilled Pathway
1.desc: Adds 15 extra points and can significantly improve invitation chances for applicants open to regional Australia.

2.title: Employer Sponsored Pathway
2.desc: For applicants with employer support, this may create a more direct route than relying only on SkillSelect competition.
